en: Colorized historical postcard showing civilians walking through a street devastated by fire and destruction. Buildings on both sides are burned-out shells, rubble and broken tram tracks cover the road, and smoke billows in the background. People in early‑20th‑century clothing move through the ruins, some in small groups, with a woman and a bearded man prominent in the foreground. A website watermark "www.elia.org.gr" appears along the bottom right.
